title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 180B — azampatti SGLang build
slug_note: The easiest install of the five known single-Spark builds, and the fastest reported coding throughput at ~43 tok/s. The catch: vision is off, so it is language-only.

variation.quant_detail: ~135GB base footprint served through SGLang at 200K context.

engine.config: SGLang at 200K context. Builder describes it as the easiest install path.

requirements.notes: Largest disk footprint of the five builds. Tightest fit on a 128GB box.

steps.text: Requires DGX Spark / GB10 (SM121), Docker with NVIDIA Container Toolkit, about 105 GiB free RAM plus 16 GiB swap at launch, and about 40 GB free disk.
The installer applies the required SM121 patches and builds the n-gram table; allow about 16 minutes for installation and 9 minutes for the first server start.

caveats: Vision is OFF — this is a language-only build. If you need image or video input, this is not the lane.
The builder states a 60 tok/s upgrade is 'days away'. Treat the current number as a floor, and treat the promise as marketing until it ships.
The checkpoint card states no license field; the weights lineage is Qwen Apache-2.0.
Builder runtimes carry their own terms on top of the weights (Mia's scripts are AGPL-3.0).
